claims.value: UI-Mate-democua-27B is a demonstration-guided computer-use agent based on Qwen3.6-27B. It observes live screenshots and produces structured keyboard/mouse actions, optionally using a recorded workflow to adapt to tasks rather than replaying fixed coordinates.
claims.evidence: UI-Mate-democua-27B is the demonstration-guided checkpoint of UI-Mate. It observes live screenshots, reasons over the visible state, and produces structured keyboard and mouse actions
Input: task instruction, screenshots, interaction history, and an optional demonstration workflow
Output: reasoning, a concise action description, and structured computer-use tool calls
Output: reasoning, a concise action description, and structured computer-use tool calls
We recommend using the official prompt, response parser, and interaction harness from the [UI-Mate repository](https://github.com/Tencent/UI-Mate).
Structured actions compatible with `pyautogui`, served through an OpenAI-compatible interface.
